title: Hunt.io reports an intrusion crew's exposed files show credential attacks on US law firms; no breach of any firm found
date_note: Hunt.io's report is dated 25 November; the observed activity ran from October, and the report gives no single event day.
summary: Hunt.io says open web directories left by an unnamed crew held target lists, scan results, logs and malware, with law firms, federal agencies, a hospital system and a manufacturer targeted. It says Simpson Thacher & Bartlett was under sustained credential attack and that CVE-2019-19781 was tried against Citrix gateways, but every captured result showed failure. Hunt.io says named is not breached; Cyber Press relays the findings.
plain: A security firm found files left online by attackers showing they tried to break into US law firms and other targets. It found no evidence any law firm was breached.
exec: Hunt.io says law firms were targeted with stolen-credential and old Citrix flaw attempts, with no confirmed breach.
action: Hunt.io advises requiring MFA on VPN and Citrix gateways, patching the listed CVEs, removing management interfaces from the internet and alerting on credential-stuffing patterns.

sources.name: Hunt.io: open directory, US hospital, manufacturer and law firms

validation.note: Hunt.io is the only original source; Cyber Press relays its report.
